title: Local macOS focused-native qualification versus hosted P8-F contract

cleanSource.method: Clean shared local clone in /private/tmp; no untracked workspace fixtures or generated byproducts copied.
cleanSource.workspaceControl: The same digest command in the main workspace refused because untracked fixtures and build byproducts entered selected scopes. The clean clone avoids that issue; no existing files were removed.

host.limitation: This is not the macos-15 GitHub-hosted runner specified by the qualification matrix.

contract.boundary: The focused macOS job specifies macos-15 ARM64 and invokes the qualification runner with --require-github-runner. Its receipt verifier binds authenticated GitHub job/run metadata and uploaded artifact identity. A local focused run can supply diagnostic evidence only, not the hosted job or sealed API/artifact-qualified receipt.
contract.priorReceiptScope: Its clean local macOS results qualify the separate package profile for earlier package inputs; the same receipt leaves hosted focused-native macOS pending.

result: NOT RUN: the local focused-native build cannot meet the requested hosted P8-F contract on this host. No platform gate, format claim, workflow result, status overlay, or branch policy is changed. Resume with a source-matched macos-15 hosted job and its sealed, API-verified receipt; local package or focused diagnostics must be reported separately.
